tools.name: search_phrases
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how to say something in Emirati Arabic (the spoken dialect of the UAE, not formal Arabic), or wants Emirati phrases about a topic. Search in English, Easy Latin or Arabic. Returns up to 10 phrases, each with Arabic script, an easy Latin spelling, the English meaning, who

tools.name: get_phrase
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a yani.study phrase link, or to show one phrase from an earlier result in full. Takes the phrase's page URL or the last part of it.

tools.name: list_situations
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know which everyday situations in the UAE Yani's Emirati phrasebook covers (greetings, the doctor, the pharmacy, directions…), to pick one for get_situation.

tools.name: get_situation
tools.description: Use this when the user wants Emirati phrases for a situation in the UAE, such as greetings, a visit to the doctor, the pharmacy or asking for directions. Takes a situation's id or title from list_situations. Returns up to 10 phrases, real recordings first.
